long_description:
Celebrate Diwali with DJ Prashant at a family-friendly dance party in Beaverton. Come early for free sweets!

About this Event

This Diwali, let's gather our friends and family for an evening of music, celebration, and togetherness! 🪔
Jai Ho! Dance Party invites you to the Diwali Festival of Lights Bollywood Party on Saturday, November 14, at XPLOR in Portland, featuring DJ Prashant.
We've planned an evening with something for everyone! Start by catching up with friends, meeting new people, and connecting with the community. Then enjoy a special live music celebration as DJ Prashant introduces Colors of Love 2, his second cover album, followed by an interactive dance session and a Bollywood DJ party.
WHAT'S HAPPENING THROUGHOUT THE EVENING?
8:30 PM – Community Hour: Enjoy free sweets while you meet, mingle, and connect with friends, families, and members of the community.9:30 PM onwards – Dance & DJ Party: Join an interactive dance session with DJ Prashant, followed by a night of Bollywood music and dancing.Bring your family, invite your friends, and come celebrate Diwali with us. Everyone is welcome!
